scenario: cumulative-cursor session skips drawing fragments, visibly cutting the final O in HELLO

tags.drawing: HELLO followed by additional short and multi-band text

notes: The real DS displayed HELLO with the lower half of the final O missing. The first host rebroadcast contains offsets 0x0000 through 0x05a0, then jumps to 0x06e0: offset 0x0640 is absent and contains the O's lower tile row. Firmware cursor telemetry at logical reply 11 shows an idle reply queued while the preceding drawing acknowledgement was unresolved; a later idle acknowledgement advanced the drawing cursor. Later messages omit other offsets through the same race. The capture ends with a truncated PCAP record because the server capture writer did not finalize its last record; all cited first-message frames precede that record and decode cleanly.

evidence.physical_result: HELLO rendered with the lower half of O missing
